reason: The text explicitly contains Joshua's command to the Israelites: 'Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout' (Joshua 6:10). Joshua commands the Hebrew people to remain silent and forbids them from expressing themselves through voice or speech, with their mouths remaining closed until given explicit permission. This is a direct and unambiguous discouragement from expressing their views.
